Elections Committee
Tuesday, February 20, 2024
3:00 PM, 1200 Minnesota Senate Bldg.
Minutes
Present: Senator Jim Carlson - Chair, Senator Bonnie S. Westlin Vice Chair, Senator Bruce
D. Anderson, Senator Calvin K. Bahr, Senator Liz Boldon, Senator Steve A. Cwodzinski,
Senator Gene Dornink, Senator Mark W. Koran, Senator Warren Limmer, Senator John Marty,
Senator Andrew Mathews, Senator Nicole Mitchell, Senator Lindsey Port, Senator Ann H. Rest
Absent: No Members Absent
Senator Jim Carlson called the meeting to order at 3:07 pm.
Call to order
Quorum is present.
S.F. 3942: Senator Boldon: Local candidates public finance group authorization.
Testifier:
Senator Boldon
Senator Boldon moved that SF 3942 be recommended to pass and re-referred to the State & Local
Government & Veterans Committee. Senator Anderson requested a roll call, and a roll call was
granted.
Senator Carlson - Aye
Senator Westlin - Aye
Senator Koran - Nay
Senator Anderson - Nay
Senator Bahr - Nay
Senator Boldon - Aye
Senator Cwodzinski - Aye
Senator Dornink - Nay
Senator Limmer - Nay
Senator Marty - Aye
Senator Mathews – Nay
Senator Mitchell – Aye
Senator Port - Aye
Senator Rest – Aye
With a roll call vote of 8 Ayes and 6 Nays, the motion prevailed.
Senator Boldon moved that S.F. 3942, be recommended to pass and re-referred to the State and
Local Government and Veterans Committee. By a voice vote - MOTION PREVAILED.

S.F. 3457: Senator Westlin: Amending amounts reportable for certain items in principal reports.
Testifiers:
Senator Westlin
Paul Cassidy, Representing the Minnesota Government Relations Council
Kate Klossner, Legislative Chair, Minnesota Government Relations Council
Senator Westlin moved the A1 Author’s Amendment. By a voice vote, the motion prevailed, and the
A1 Author’s Amendment was adopted.
SF 3457 was laid over.
S.F. 3555: Senator Carlson: Sheriff or county attorney position vacancy special election
requirement.
Testifiers:
Senator Carlson
Matt Massman, Executive Director, Minnesota Inter-County Association
Laurie Halverson, Commissioner, Dakota County
Senator Carlson moved the A5 Author’s Amendment. By a voice vote, the motion prevailed, and the
A5 Author’s Amendment was adopted.
Senator Boldon moved that S.F. 3555, as amended, recommended to pass and re-referred to the
State and Local Government and Veterans Committee. By a voice vote - MOTION PREVAILED.
The meeting was adjourned at 5:38 pm.
